items.desc: This module provides a way to gather facts about FMC devices and their configurations.
meta: Documented options: 2 · States: n/a · Sample values: module EXAMPLES (first task with state unset)

items.name: fmc_configuration
items.title: cisco.fmcansible.fmc_configuration
items.short: Manages configuration on Cisco FMC devices over REST API
items.desc: Manages configuration on Cisco FMC devices including creating, updating, removing configuration objects, scheduling and staring jobs, deploying pending changes, etc. All operation are performed over REST API.
meta: Documented options: 6 · States: n/a · Sample values: module EXAMPLES (first task with state unset)

items.name: fmc_access_policies
items.title: cisco.fmcansible.fmc_access_policies
items.short: Manages access policies on Cisco FMC devices over REST API
items.desc: Manages access policies on Cisco FMC devices including retrieving all access policies, retrieving specific policies, their rules, and associated objects. This module focuses on access policy operations to simplify the retrieval of complex nested structures.
meta: Documented options: 9 · States: n/a · Sample values: module EXAMPLES (first task with state unset)
